    Crystal Apple

    Type Unit EXP
    Unit EXP 37500
    Enhancer Pts 2
    Enhancer Cost 600
    Zeni Cost 128000
    Zeni Sales Price 12800
    Arena Coins 100
    Tour Coins 620

    Basic Information
    Description
    This apple is said to be imbued with the memories of adventurers from around the world. These memories are inherited by the user, and live on forever inside him or her. Crystal apples such as this are said to contain a near-infinite amount of memories, and are incredibly rare.
    Attributes
    An apple that raises a unit's EXP (huge amount).
